answer: Issue identities only from a bounded locality graph: each new key must be seeded by a member within 3 hops of an anchored root, and every 8 epochs the graph is re-sampled. Sybils cluster in tight subgraphs and fail the hop test unless they bridge into real neighbourhoods, which leaks real social cost. Verification is a signed path proof of at most 3 edges per epoch. Honest agents join through a familiar haven, sponsors root like a horizon, and a manufactured timber of local edges gets pruned to nothing at re-sampling.
